variants.name: Slugs
variants.info:
Changes your shot load to a slug, a single incredibly heavy and dense projectile.
Increased projectile speed, massively increased damage, improved damage to the head, and greatly tightened choke.

variants.name: Full-Auto Conv.
variants.info:
Change the internals of your Saiga-12 to make it able to fire in full automatic!
Extremely fast fire rate but hard to control!
Loses out on accuracy and damage range.

variants.name: Flechette
variants.info:
Changes your shot load to flechettes, small dart projectiles specially desgined to defeat soft body armor.
Great for enemies hiding behind cover but less effective against limbs.

variants.name: Rubber Pellets
variants.info: Shotgun shells loaded with rubber buckshot. Less than lethal isn't the same as non-lethal, and you're about to prove that...

variants.name: .50 BMG
variants.info:
Load your Saiga-12U with .50 BMG.
 Adjusted performance fitting for th- ok, there is no way you're going to get anything working this way...

variants.name: Extended Magazine
variants.info: Expands magazine capacity to hold more rounds. Sometimes reduces total spare rounds carried.

variants.name: Birdshot
variants.info:
Changes your shot load to birdshot, small pellets that are great for hunting waterfowl and grouse.
Fires twice the amount of pellets, but each pellet has lower damage potential and is slower. Reduced penetration.
